newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Benazir Bhutto to visit Sri Lanka from July 23.
newsitem.headline: Benazir Bhutto to visit Sri Lanka from July 23.

text.p: Former Pakistan prime minister Benazir Bhutto will make a four-day private visit to Sri Lanka from July 23, opposition political sources said on Monday.
Bhutto, leader of the opposition Pakistan People's Party, was sacked by President Farooq Leghari in November on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
Her party suffered a heavy defeat in the subsequent general election.
She will attend celebrations to mark 25 years in politics of Anura Bandaranaike, brother of Sri Lankan President Chandrika Kumaratunga.
Bandaranaike split from the ruling People's Alliance ahead of general elections in 1994 and is now a leading member of the main opposition United National Party.
